Assessment of BA.evidence_source: Body appreciation. All participants completed the 10-item Body Appreciation Scale-2 (BAS-2; Tylka & Wood-Barcalow, 2015b).

Assessment of BMI.evidence_source: Participants also selfreported their weight (in kilograms) and height (in centimeters), which were used to calculate BMI.

section_summary.extract_value: This Measures section reports that participants completed the 10-item Body Appreciation Scale-2 (BAS-2), the Rosenberg Self-Esteem Scale (RSES), and the 5-item Satisfaction With Life Scale (SWLS). Demographic information included sex, age, highest educational qualification, and self-reported weight and height (used to calculate BMI). The section does not provide sample size, country, sampling source, mean ages, BMI values, percent white, survey administration method, or correlations between body appreciation and BMI, and no study numbering (e.g., 'Study 1') is given.
